title: Let the compiler find it
hints: Give worker's parameters directions first: jobs is only received from and results is only sent to. Then compile and read the error.
worker sends its answer back on jobs instead of results. The doubled value gets picked up again as a new job, and results never gets anything.
func worker(jobs <-chan int, results chan<- int) { for { j := <-jobs; results <- j * 2 } }
